meta.one_liner: Buy stocks that already moved big, right as they break out to new highs on volume.
meta.explainer_md: Popularized by the trader known as Qullamaggie: find stocks that gained 30%+ in the last quarter, wait for them to break above their recent 50-day high on heavier-than-usual volume, and ride the trend with a stop underneath. The idea is that big moves tend to continue — winners keep winning until they don't, which is what the 8% stop and 10-day-average exit are for.

spec.name: Momentum Breakout
spec.description: Big prior move + breakout over 50-day high with volume confirmation.
